Traditional Knowledge Examination

[TEST FIXTURE — NOT OFFICIAL TEXT] Examiners should check whether a claimed herbal formulation is anticipated by traditional knowledge, including Ayurvedic texts and TKDL records.

Claims to a mere admixture of known plant extracts such as Withania somnifera root with Curcuma longa rhizome should be assessed for synergistic effect.

Other IP Routes

Where patent protection is unavailable, applicants may consider trademark protection for the brand, design registration for packaging, or trade secret protection for process know-how.
